The '''Jabor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabor]], homeworld of the [[Jabor]]i.
